# WheelController transcripts against scripted fake HID discovery.
# Frozen from the legacy C# implementation by tools/G29.Reference (reference.ps1).
# Do not edit by hand. These vectors are the oracle for the Brainfuck port.
# scenario <name>; phases list the configurable (g29) and PS4-mode devices per re-enumeration step
# call <operation>; then the observed discovery events and 'result ok <path>' or 'result error <message>'
# native paths n*, compatibility paths c* (PID C294 rev 1350, 7-byte output), PS4 paths p* (PID C260)

scenario init-native-540-0
enumerate g29
open n1
send n1 F8811C02000000
close n1
open n1
send n1 F5000000000000
close n1
open n1
send n1 F8120000000000
close n1
result ok n1

close n1
open n1
send n1 FE0D0606810000
send n1 14000000000000
close n1
open n1
send n1 F8120000000000
close n1
result ok n1

scenario init-compatibility-native-appears-beside-old

enumerate g29

scenario init-compatibility-never-returns (8 s real timeout, enumerations not logged)
open c1
send c1 F80A0000000000
send c1 F8090501010000
close c1
result error The G29 did not reconnect in native mode. Reconnect USB and run init again.

scenario init-none
enumerate g29
enumerate ps4
result error No Logitech G29 was found. Set the selector to PS3 and reconnect USB.

scenario init-ps4
enumerate g29
enumerate ps4
result error The G29 is in PS4 mode (PID C260), which this tool cannot configure. Set the selector to PS3 and reconnect USB.

scenario init-multiple
enumerate g29
result error More than one G29 was found. Leave only the target wheel connected.

scenario init-multiple-with-ps4
enumerate g29
result error More than one G29 was found. Leave only the target wheel connected.

scenario init-open-fails
enumerate g29
open n1
open-failed n1
result error Unable to open the G29 HID interface for output. Close any program holding exclusive access and try again.

scenario init-send-fails
enumerate g29
open n1
send n1 F8818403000000
send-failed n1
close n1
result error The G29 rejected an output report.
